content: Hello, thank you for contacting Oakridge Academy's administration office. How may I assist you with your payment or enrollment today?
Hi, I'm following up to confirm that my son's tuition fee for June was received. I made the payment yesterday via Zelle.
Thank you for reaching out. Could you please provide the payment reference or the name on the transaction so I can verify your Zelle payment for June?
Sure, the payment was made from my account, Emily Santos, and the reference in Zelle was 'Tuition J. Santos - June'. The amount was $1,200, and the transaction ID is ZL56329P.

I see the Zelle transfer of $1,200 under Emily Santos, with transaction ID ZL56329P, received on June 6th. The payment is now registered for your son, Javier Santos, student ID 404293. This ensures his enrollment is secured for the term.
Thank you. Can I get an email confirmation for my records? My email is emily.santos@email.com.
Absolutely. I will send a payment confirmation to emily.santos@email.com within the next 15 minutes. If you do not receive it by 5:00 PM today, please let us know immediately so we can resend.
Perfect, thanks for your quick help. Just to confirm, there are no outstanding balances, right?
Correct, Emily. As of today, Javier Santos (ID: 404293) has a zero balance for the June term. Your timely Zelle payment has been fully processed and no further action is required at this moment.
